ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 1:3 ratio of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, irregular high-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal thirds of both lobes. The central and proximal regions are predominantly low-intensity black with sparse, discrete white focal spots and small clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex upward curvature along the posterior margins of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly posteriorly-recurved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel formations localized on the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization or attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel white linear tracks; notably a sharp vertical 20-30 pixel disruption on the lower central portion of the left lobe and various shorter oblique marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast scarring and mottling on the lateral margins of both lobes; visible biological encrustation (barnacles) on the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A dark-colored, rounded biological form (consistent with a pinniped head) is visible in the foreground water below the left fluke lobe.
